subject: Hospitality
title: Social Media and Food Photography
description: A short lesson to help you apply Social Media and Food Photography.

hook.text: Instagram changed how restaurants design food. If a dish doesn't look good in photos, it won't succeed in today's market.

buildup.text: Restaurants now design for 'Instagrammability'—colorful presentations, unique plating, neon signs, and photogenic interiors.

discovery.text: User-generated content on Instagram and TikTok provides free marketing worth thousands. One viral post can create overnight fame.

twist.text: Some chefs resent it. They argue diners care more about photographing food than tasting it. The meal becomes a prop.

climax.text: Restaurants now hire social media managers and even design dishes specifically to trend online. The plate is a billboard.

punchline.text: Taste for the mouth, beauty for the phone. Dining is now a visual medium.

quiz.question: How has Instagram changed restaurant design?
options: Restaurants design food and spaces for visual appeal and shareable photos
Restaurants only use it for reservations
